description: Abstract base class for handling storage of content entities in Drupal, including cache management, revision handling, translation support, and entity lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: ContentEntityStorageBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core storage handling for content entities, including cache management, revision handling, translation, and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity instance with optional initial values, invoking preCreate and postCreate hooks.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the storage class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate an entity object based on bundle info and initialize fields.

methods.name: getBundleFromClass
methods.description: Determines the bundle name associated with a given class name.

methods.name: getBundleFromValues
methods.description: Extracts the bundle name from an array of entity field values.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the entity class name, considering bundle-specific overrides.

methods.name: createWithSampleValues
methods.description: Creates an entity with sample data, excluding ID and revision fields.

methods.name: initFieldValues
methods.description: Initializes entity fields with provided values or defaults, and invokes hooks.

methods.name: isAnyRevisionTranslated
methods.description: Checks if any revision of the entity has translations.

methods.name: isAnyStoredRevisionTranslated
methods.description: Checks if any stored revision of the entity has translations.

methods.name: createTranslation
methods.description: Creates a translation for an entity in a specified language.

methods.name: createRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of an entity, merging translations as needed.

methods.name: getRevisionTranslationMergeSkippedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns field names to skip when merging revision translations.

methods.name: getLatestRevisionId
methods.description: Retrieves the latest revision ID for an entity.

methods.name: getLatestTranslationAffectedRevisionId
methods.description: Retrieves the latest revision ID affected by translation for an entity.

methods.name: loadRevision
methods.description: Loads a specific revision by ID.

methods.name: loadMultipleRevisions
methods.description: Loads multiple revisions by their IDs, utilizing caches and storage.

methods.name: loadRevisionUnchanged
methods.description: Loads a revision ignoring static cache, returning the revision object.

methods.name: doLoadMultipleRevisionsFieldItems
methods.description: Abstract method to load revision field items from storage.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Handles saving an entity, managing revision flags and invoking hooks.

methods.name: doSaveFieldItems
methods.description: Abstract method to write entity field values to storage.

methods.name: doPreSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook to validate and prepare entity before saving.

methods.name: doPostSave
methods.description: Post-save hook to finalize entity state after saving.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes entities and their field data.

methods.name: doDeleteFieldItems
methods.description: Abstract method to delete field data for entities.

methods.name: deleteRevision
methods.description: Deletes a specific revision, ensuring it is not default.

methods.name: doDeleteRevisionFieldItems
methods.description: Abstract method to delete revision field data.

methods.name: invokeTranslationHooks
methods.description: Triggers hooks related to translation insertion or deletion.

methods.name: invokeStorageLoadHook
methods.description: Invokes storage load hooks for a set of entities.

methods.name: invokeHook
methods.description: Invokes specific hooks based on the operation (presave, insert, update).

methods.name: invokeFieldMethod
methods.description: Calls a method on all fields of an entity, across translations.

methods.name: invokeFieldPostSave
methods.description: Calls postSave on fields and triggers field data save if needed.

methods.name: hasFieldValueChanged
methods.description: Checks if a field's value has changed compared to the original entity.

methods.name: populateAffectedRevisionTranslations
methods.description: Sets the affected flag for translation revisions.

methods.name: cleanIds
methods.description: Sanitizes entity IDs, especially for integer fields.

methods.name: getFromPersistentCache
methods.description: Retrieves entities from persistent cache by IDs.

methods.name: getFromPersistentRevisionCache
methods.description: Retrieves revision entities from cache.

methods.name: setPersistentCache
methods.description: Stores entities in persistent cache.

methods.name: setPersistentRevisionCache
methods.description: Stores revision entities in cache.

methods.name: buildRevisionCacheId
methods.description: Constructs cache ID for a revision.

methods.name: getFromStaticRevisionCache
methods.description: Retrieves revisions from static cache.

methods.name: setStaticCache
methods.description: Stores entities in static cache, including revisions.

methods.name: loadUnchanged
methods.description: Loads an entity ignoring cache invalidation, returning unchanged entity.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Clears static and persistent caches for entities.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Deprecated property accessor for latestRevisionIds.

methods.name: resetRevisionCache
methods.description: Clears static and persistent revision caches.
